properties.text: We work with two referral partners, Northwind Consulting and Blue Harbour Advisory. Partners introduce customers and help them get started; we pay a referral fee for the first year.
properties.title: Partner programme overview

properties.text: From 1 February 2026, Growth and Enterprise list prices rise by 6% for new customers. Existing customers keep their price until renewal. Starter is unchanged.
properties.title: Pricing update memo

properties.text:
Support reorg, effective 15 March 2026.

Why: the Integrations team is small and its volume has been falling, while Platform support is stretched. We'll merge the two.

What changes: the Integrations queue is retired on 15 March. Integrations specialists join Platform support. General support and Billing are unchanged.

Owner: Rosa (Head of Support).
properties.title: Reorg plan: support teams 2026

properties.text: H1: Advanced reporting (custom reports, scheduled exports), released 1 April. Mobile app offline mode. H2: workspace permissions, a refreshed dashboard designer.
properties.title: Product roadmap 2026

properties.text: First response times: Enterprise within 4 working hours, Growth and Starter within one working day. Breaches are reported weekly to the Head of Customer Success.
properties.title: SLA policy v2

properties.name: Blue Harbour Advisory
properties.notes: Referral partner since 2024. Refers mid-sized retailers. No special terms.

properties.name: Northwind Consulting
properties.notes: Referral partner since 2025. Promised the clients it refers quarterly invoicing as part of its consulting package. We bill monthly.
